nodes.label: Mill Opening Ceremony Photo
nodes.rationale: Inauguration of the oil mill: guests in masks light a traditional brass nilavilakku lamp garlanded with marigolds inside the new mill shed. Supports the About page founding / heritage story.

nodes.label: Neeram Coconut Oil Product Banner
nodes.rationale: Marketing hero banner: Neeram coconut oil pouch and two PET bottles on wooden deck against coconut palm fronds with golden oil splash; Malayalam tagline 'Neeram - the true colour of good coconut oil'. Pouch reads 'An elixir of life from God's own country'. Used as About page / hero brand banner.

nodes.label: Govindan Oil Mill, Anakallu
nodes.rationale: Exterior of the red-and-white mill building with signboard 'Govindan Oil Mill, Anakallu' (with GSTIN and phone). Establishes the real manufacturing facility behind the Neeram brand on the About page.

nodes.label: Neeram Bottle Cap Close-up
nodes.rationale: Product detail shot of a clear bottle of golden coconut oil with white cap and tamper-evident seal printed 'Neeram' in blue. Gallery image emphasizing packaging integrity and oil clarity.

nodes.label: Neeram Coconut Oil Label Close-up
nodes.rationale: Gallery detail of the bottle label: Neeram logo, 'Coconut Oil - Double Filtered', batch/mfg/exp fields, 'Best before six months from manufacture'. Communicates transparency and product facts.

nodes.label: Sambar Food Photo
nodes.rationale: Overhead food photography: steel bowl of vegetable sambar with drumsticks and curry leaves, white rice and tamarind on a banana leaf over rustic wood. Lifestyle/recipe imagery tying the oil to everyday South Indian cooking.

nodes.label: Tempering Pan Food Photo
nodes.rationale: Moody close-up of a cast-iron pan on a stove with sizzling oil, dried red chillies, curry leaves and mustard seeds (tadka/tempering). Shows coconut oil in use in traditional cooking.

nodes.label: 3D Scroll-Spinning Bottle Animation
nodes.rationale: Signature feature: bottle rotates 360 degrees (frames 1-120) while travelling from hero to feature slot, scrubbed by scroll. Canvas in document flow avoids fixed-to-static swap.

nodes.rationale: Still photo shows at progress <=0.01 and >=0.99; canvas fades in while moving. Photo is LCP image aligned pixel-for-pixel with frame 1; swap ordering prevents background showing through.
